Do thorough research, find things the user has NOT thought of yet (unknown unknowns), do non-destructive work only (extract to /tmp/opencode/canonical-ux-audit/, never modify originals).

Base understanding: canonical is `smart-files` lineage (smart-core + smart-ui-egui + xtask), NOT smart-desktop shell, NOT full eiga media player. Key zips:
- /home/lufuno/smart/smart-suite/apps/build-production-rust-file-manager-2-very-good.zip

- /home/lufuno/work/BIGBOY/refine-futuristic-desktop-environment-bad2.zip (smart-desktop, for reference only)
- /home/lufuno/Documents/rust-wasm-media-manager-latest.zip (eiga-core)

Your focus:
1. UX COMPLETENESS AUDIT - Compare chrome.rs/content.rs/app.rs/modals.rs/overlays.rs/photos.rs/shell.rs/terminal.rs/copyfx.rs/paint.rs/theme/icons/appkit across those zips by size and feature. List which version has best version of each file and what each lacks. E.g. terminal.rs 120k vs 86k, chrome 64k vs 71k vs 72k, etc. Do not trust zip titles.
2. VIDEO THUMBNAILS BLAZING - User says file manager DOES need some eiga stuff for blazing video thumbnails. Audit eiga-core (player/source/subs) + smart-core analyze.rs + video.rs/highlight.rs/pty/storage/termlive + thumbs.rs/gen_thumbs.py. Find the fastest thumbnail pipeline and how to integrate into file manager without shipping full media player. Propose UX for gallery grid, filmstrip, lazy loading, caching.
3. DRAG FOLDER TO TAB BUG - It opens now but doesn't paste. Trace drag-drop in chrome/content/ops/backend. Find root cause and spec fix, including paste preview, conflict, progress, cancel.
4. SETTINGS CLEANUP - Settings view has wallpapers/desktop stuff it shouldn't. List every current setting key found in smart-files and smart-desktop, mark file-manager relevant vs wallpaper/assistant/capture/desktop to REMOVE. Propose final file-manager-only settings.
5. CATCH ALL LIES - Find every lie/stub the app does: unimplemented buttons, TODOs, panic!/unimplemented!/todo!, demo FS presented as real, fake progress bars, silent failures, hardcoded fake devices, fake search results, disabled trash/archive actions. Grep for todo/unimplemented/fake/demo. List file:line and required honest behavior. No stubs allowed for $299.
6. PHONE/USB DISCOVERY UX - User connected phone, never appeared as mounted. Audit devices.rs/vfs.rs/mounts UX. What does user see when phone plugged? What diagnostics are missing? Propose mount indicator, fallback, error surfacing.
7. PERFORMANCE + UNKNOWN UNKNOWNS - Large-folder rendering, search responsiveness, thumbnail cache, memory, error handling, accessibility, keyboard shortcuts, etc. Deliberately look for edge cases user didn't list.
8. OUTPUT: Write /tmp/opencode/canonical-ux-audit/UX-SPECS.md with: feature matrix, per-file best version table, drag-paste fix spec, settings in/out list, lie inventory, thumbnail pipeline spec, phone-mount UX spec, performance budget, unknown-unknowns list, and final UX acceptance criteria. Also print summary to your final answer. Do not merge code yet, do not modify originals. Focus on making it completely usable.

585:     // ───────────── navigation ─────────────
586:     pub fn navigate(&mut self, r: Route) {
587:         if self.hist.get(self.hist_i) == Some(&r) && !self.entries.is_empty() {
588:             return;
589:         }
590:         self.hist.truncate(self.hist_i + 1);
591:         self.hist.push(r.clone());
592:         self.hist_i = self.hist.len() - 1;
593:         self.go(r);
594:     }
595:     fn go(&mut self, r: Route) {
596:         self.route = r.clone();
597:         // Smart contextual sorting: Downloads is almost always "what did I just get?",
598:         // so newest-first wins there unless the user turned smart sort off.
599:         if self.st().smart_sort {
600:             if let Route::Loc(l) = &r {
601:                 let base = l.name().to_ascii_lowercase();
602:                 if base == "downloads" || base == "download" {
603:                     self.set(|s| {
604:                         s.sort = SortKey::Modified;
605:                         s.ascending = false;
606:                     });
607:                 }
608:             }
609:         }
610:         self.sel.clear();
611:         self.select_mode = false;
612:         self.anchor = None;
613:         self.focus = None;
614:         self.rename = None;
615:         self.clear_search();
616:         self.scroll_to = Some(0);
617:         self.load();
618:     }
619:     pub fn can_back(&self) -> bool {
620:         self.hist_i > 0
621:     }
622:     pub fn can_fwd(&self) -> bool {
623:         self.hist_i + 1 < self.hist.len()
624:     }
625:     pub fn load(&mut self) {
626:         self.loading = true;
627:         self.error = None;
628:         match self.route.clone() {
629:             Route::Loc(l) => {
630:                 self.listing_req = self.be.list(&l);
631:                 self.be.watch(&l);
632:             }
633:             Route::Recents => {
634:                 let recents = self.lib(|l| l.recents.clone());
635:                 let items: Vec<Entry> = recents.iter().filter_map(|r| self.be.stat(&r.loc).ok()).collect();
636:                 self.set_entries(items);
637:             }
638:             Route::Tag(id) => {
639:                 let locs = self.lib(|l| l.tagged(&id));
640:                 let items: Vec<Entry> = locs.iter().filter_map(|l| self.be.stat(l).ok()).collect();
641:                 self.set_entries(items);
642:             }
643:         }
644:     }
645:     pub fn title(&self) -> String {
646:         match &self.route {
647:             Route::Recents => "Recents".into(),
648:             Route::Tag(id) => self.lib(|l| l.tags.iter().find(|t| &t.id == id).map(|t| t.name.clone())).unwrap_or_else(|| id.clone()),
649:             Route::Loc(l) => self.loc_title(l),
650:         }
651:     }
652:     pub fn loc_title(&self, l: &Location) -> String {
653:         if let Some(p) = self.places.iter().find(|p| &p.loc == l) {
654:             return p.title.clone();
655:         }
656:         if l.is_root() {
657:             if let Some(d) = self.devices.iter().find(|d| d.loc.as_ref() == Some(l)) {
658:                 return d.name.clone();
659:             }
660:             return if l.fs == "file" { "Computer".into() } else { l.fs.clone() };
661:         }
662:         l.name()
663:     }
664:     pub fn crumbs(&self) -> Vec<(String, Route)> {
665:         match &self.route {
666:             Route::Recents => vec![("Smart".into(), Route::Loc(self.be.home())), ("Recents".into(), Route::Recents)],
667:             Route::Tag(_) => vec![("Tags".into(), Route::Recents), (self.title(), self.route.clone())],
668:             Route::Loc(l) => {
669:                 let home = self.be.home();
670:                 let mut v: Vec<(String, Route)> = vec![];
671:                 if l.starts_with(&home) {
672:                     v.push(("Smart".into(), Route::Loc(home.clone())));
673:                     for a in l.ancestors().iter().filter(|a| a.starts_with(&home) && **a != home) {
674:                         v.push((a.name(), Route::Loc(a.clone())));
675:                     }
676:                     if *l == home {
677:                         v.push(("Home".into(), Route::Loc(home)));
678:                     }
679:                 } else {
680:                     for a in l.ancestors() {
681:                         v.push((self.loc_title(&a), Route::Loc(a)));
682:                     }
683:                 }
684:                 v
685:             }
686:         }
687:     }

689:     // ───────────── listing / view ─────────────
690:     pub fn set_entries(&mut self, e: Vec<Entry>) {
691:         self.entries = e;
692:         self.loading = false;
693:         self.rebuild_view();
694:         let want: Vec<Location> = std::mem::take(&mut self.select_after_list);
695:         if !want.is_empty() {
696:             self.sel = want.iter().cloned().collect();
697:             if let Some(i) = self.items.iter().position(|e| want.contains(&e.loc)) {
698:                 self.focus = Some(i);
699:                 self.anchor = Some(i);
700:                 self.scroll_to = Some(i);
701:             }
702:         }
703:         let alive: HashSet<Location> = self.items.iter().map(|e| e.loc.clone()).collect();
704:         self.sel.retain(|l| alive.contains(l));
705:         let todo: Vec<Location> = self.items.iter().filter(|e| e.is_dir && !self.summaries.contains_key(&e.loc)).take(80).map(|e| e.loc.clone()).collect();
706:         for l in todo {
707:             self.be.summarize(&l);
708:         }
709:     }
710:     fn group_idx(e: &Entry, by_kind: bool) -> usize {
711:         if e.is_dir {
712:             return 0;
713:         }
714:         if !by_kind {
715:             return 1;
716:         }
717:         match e.kind {
718:             Kind::Image | Kind::Vector => 1,
719:             Kind::Audio => 2,
720:             Kind::Video => 3,
721:             Kind::Pdf | Kind::Document | Kind::Text | Kind::Code => 4,
722:             _ => 5,
723:         }
724:     }
725:     pub fn rebuild_view(&mut self) {
726:         let s = self.st();
727:         let mut v: Vec<Entry> = self.entries.iter().filter(|e| s.show_hidden || !e.hidden).cloned().collect();
728:         sort_entries(&mut v, s.sort, s.ascending, s.folders_first);
729:         let by_kind = s.sort == SortKey::Name && s.folders_first;
730:         if s.folders_first {
731:             v.sort_by_key(|e| Self::group_idx(e, by_kind)); // stable: name order kept inside groups
732:         }
733:         let titles = ["Folders", "Images", "Audio", "Video", "Documents", "Files"];
734:         let mut secs: Vec<Section> = vec![];
735:         for (i, e) in v.iter().enumerate() {
736:             let g = Self::group_idx(e, by_kind);
737:             let t = if !s.folders_first { "Items".to_string() } else if by_kind { titles[g].to_string() } else if g == 0 { "Folders".into() } else { "Files".into() };
738:             if secs.last().map(|x| x.title != t).unwrap_or(true) {
739:                 if let Some(l) = secs.last_mut() {
740:                     l.end = i;
741:                 }
742:                 secs.push(Section { title: t, folders: g == 0 && s.folders_first, start: i, end: v.len() });
743:             }
744:         }
745:         self.items = v;
746:         self.sections = secs;
747:     }
748:     pub fn selected(&self) -> Vec<Entry> {
749:         let mut v: Vec<Entry> = self.items.iter().filter(|e| self.sel.contains(&e.loc)).cloned().collect();
750:         if v.is_empty() {
751:             v = self.search.hits.iter().filter(|h| self.sel.contains(&h.entry.loc)).map(|h| h.entry.clone()).collect();
752:         }
753:         v
754:     }
755:     pub fn total_bytes(&self) -> u64 {
756:         self.items.iter().map(|e| if e.is_dir { self.summaries.get(&e.loc).map(|s| s.1).unwrap_or(0) } else { e.size }).sum()
757:     }
758:     pub fn tag_colors(&self, l: &Location) -> Vec<egui::Color32> {
759:         self.lib(|lib| lib.tags_of(l).iter().map(|t| hex(&t.color)).collect())
760:     }

762:     // ───────────── search ─────────────
763:     pub fn clear_search(&mut self) {
764:         self.be.cancel_search();
765:         self.search.query.clear();
766:         self.search.hits.clear();
767:         self.search.last_sent.clear();
768:         self.search.done = false;
769:     }
770:     pub fn search_active(&self) -> bool {
771:         !self.search.query.trim().is_empty()
772:     }
773:     pub fn run_search(&mut self) {
774:         let q = self.search.query.trim().to_string();
775:         if q.is_empty() {
776:             self.clear_search();
777:             return;
778:         }
779:         let scope = if self.search.everywhere || self.current_loc().is_none() { self.be.home() } else { self.target_dir() };
780:         let contents = self.st().search_contents;
781:         self.search.hits.clear();
782:         self.search.done = false;
783:         self.search.last_sent = q.clone();
784:         self.search.req = self.be.search(&q, &scope, contents);
785:         self.sel.clear();
786:         self.focus = None;
787:     }

789:     // ───────────── event pump ─────────────
790:     pub fn pump(&mut self, ctx: &Context) {
791:         let mut repaint = false;
792:         for ev in self.be.poll() {
793:             repaint = true;
794:             match ev {
795:                 Event::Listed { req, loc, result } => {
796:                     if req == self.listing_req {
797:                         match result {
798:                             Ok(v) => self.set_entries(v),
799:                             Err(e) => {
800:                                 self.error = Some(e);
801:                                 self.loading = false;
802:                                 self.entries.clear();
803:                                 self.rebuild_view();
804:                             }

905:     fn on_job(&mut self, j: JobEvent) {
906:         match j {
907:             JobEvent::Started { id, title } => self.jobs.push(JobView { id, title, done: 0, total: 1, current: String::new(), state: JobState::Running, age: 0.0 }),
908:             JobEvent::Progress { id, done, total, current } => {
909:                 if let Some(v) = self.jobs.iter_mut().find(|v| v.id == id) {
910:                     v.done = done;
911:                     v.total = total.max(1);
912:                     v.current = current;
913:                 }
914:             }
915:             JobEvent::Finished { id, created, touched } => {
916:                 if let Some(v) = self.jobs.iter_mut().find(|v| v.id == id) {
917:                     v.state = JobState::Done;
918:                     v.done = v.total;
919:                     v.age = 0.0;
920:                     if self.copy_dialog == Some(id) {
921:                         self.copy_dialog = None;
922:                     }
923:                 }
924:                 if let Some(cur) = self.current_loc() {
925:                     if touched.contains(&cur) {
926:                         self.select_after_list = created;
927:                         self.listing_req = self.be.list(&cur);
928:                     }
929:                 }
930:                 self.be.refresh_devices();
931:             }
932:             JobEvent::Failed { id, error } => {
933:                 if let Some(v) = self.jobs.iter_mut().find(|v| v.id == id) {
934:                     v.state = JobState::Failed(error.clone());
935:                     v.age = 0.0;
936:                 }
937:                 if error != "cancelled" {
938:                     self.toast(error, false);
939:                 }
940:                 if let Some(cur) = self.current_loc() {
941:                     self.listing_req = self.be.list(&cur);
942:                 }
943:             }
944:         }
945:     }

### 2.2 Fastest thumbnail pipeline (winner)

**Winner: `prod2` `thumbs.rs` + `video_thumb()`**. Why:

- Single `ffmpeg` invocation, `-ss 0.7` (fast seek via keyframe, not full decode), `scale='min(384,iw)':-2` (never upscale, even dimensions preserved), `-frames:v 1` (decode 1 frame), pipe to `image` crate, disk cache keyed by `fnv1a(real_path)`. No `ffprobe` overhead per thumb, no player state, no loop.
- `Thumbs` queue is LIFO (`q.pop()` = newest-first) on 2 workers — on-screen items finish first; `seen: HashSet<(Location,edge)>` dedupes; `forget()` on Refresh unblocks; `poll()` drains 2/frame on web (no threads).
- `prod2` is the **only** version where dropped video thumbs actually appear; eiga/prod1/develop paint blank + `thumb_failed` forever. `eiga`’s `ffmpeg` pipe is continuous playback (expensive, needs frame sync, OSD, audio) — 50–100× slower for galleries.

**Do NOT ship**: `video.rs` (76 KB player), `eiga-core` player/source pipes, `player.rs` tick loop, `subs.rs` parser. **Do ship**: `highlight.rs`, `thumbs.rs` video_thumb (extracted as standalone `thumb_video` feature), `analyze.rs` scan pattern (for prefetch/prioritization), `storage.rs` if Storage tab wanted, `pty`/`termlive` only if Terminal live shell wanted.

### 2.3 Integration spec — file-manager `gallery/` without player

**Pipeline (native desktop):**

1. Content view requests thumbs for visible rows only (`request_thumb_for(&e)` in `content.rs:69` for `Kind::Image` today → extend to `Kind::Video`). Edge = `204` (grid) or `600+` (preview `big_thumbs`).
2. `Thumbs::request()` dedupes via `seen`. Two worker threads `decode()`.
3. `decode()`:
   - If `image` succeeds → `thumbnail(edge,edge)` → `ThumbResult`.
   - Else if `Kind::Video` and native → `video_thumb()` as above, but locked to ONE `ffmpeg` per file at a time (semaphore), with 3 s timeout. On `ffmpeg` missing → return `None` → fallback glyph (see UX below), **never** fake frame.
4. `Event::Thumb` in `app.rs:pump()` → `ctx.load_texture("th-<path>-<edge>")` → `thumbs` or `big_thumbs` map. On empty (`size[0]==0`) → `thumb_failed.insert(loc)` (avoid retry loop). On `Refresh` → `thumbs.clear()` + `forget()` + `be.forget_thumb` (today `app.rs:988`).
5. **Cache**: `dirs::cache_dir()/smart-files/thumbs/<hex>.png` (384 px max). LRU evict at **500 MB** or **10k files** (whichever first) via `atime` sweep on startup. Never block UI on cache scan. Web build: no `ffmpeg`, no disk cache; serve `image` thumbs only + glyph for video (honest label *“Video preview unavailable in browser”*).

**UX — gallery grid:**

- Grid cell = 16:9 card (video) or square (image) with `thumb_scale` (0.75–1.4, `Ctrl +/-`) driving `cols` + `edge`. `T_META` filename truncated via `fit()` + `kind_label()`.
- While decoding: `grade_fill(kind_color)` + `ico(kind.icon())` + shimmer (respect `reduce_motion` → static). **Never** blank white.
- On `thumb_failed`: `clapperboard` glyph + `duration` badge (`ffprobe` cached, 1 call/file max) + `Retry` on hover. No spin forever.
- On hover (grid): `tick_badge` (22 px, top-left) + `menu-dots` (top-right, 28 px) **must not overlap** (see §8-P5). Both use `Sense::click()` with `Id::unique`; `resp.hovered()` required, not `hovered||checked`.
- Gallery entry: `Photos` app already has `all/favs/folders`; files gallery reuses `thumbs` map. Add **Filmstrip** in Preview (`Modal::Preview`): horizontal strip of N=5 frames for video (extract at 0.5s, 25%, 50%, 75%, 90% on demand, cached as `<key>-5.<n>.png`), click seeks preview thumbnail (still image, not playback). `Space` toggles Filmstrip ↔ Large. **No autoplay**.
- **Lazy loading**: `content.rs` already virtualizes by viewport (`ITEM_RECTS` + `hits` in `132`). Keep: request only intersecting rows; cancel off-screen queued `seen` entries after 2 s.
- **Caching**: keep `thumbs` HashMap capped at **400** entries (LRU by `time`); evict oldest (free `TextureHandle`). Today unbounded → memory leak (§9-P8). `big_thumbs` capped at **8** (preview only).
- **Accessibility**: grid cells focusable via arrows (`lib.rs` arrow nav already), `Home/End/PageUp/Down`, `Enter` opens, `Space` previews, `F2` renames, `Ctrl+O` opens. Announce `aria-label` via `egui` `WidgetText`? At least `on_hover_text` with full filename + duration.
- **Honesty**: If `ffmpeg` missing, show `video` glyph + `“Install ffmpeg for video thumbnails”` toast once + `Open terminal` action. Never show stale frame of different file (cache key must include `mtime`).

**What to extract (minimal video delta):**

- `crates/smart-core/src/thumbs.rs` ← prod2 `video_thumb` + `smart_hash` + `decode` (91→145 lines). Keep `image` features `png,jpeg` only.

- `crates/smart-core/src/analyze.rs` ← eiga (for storage + future prefetch) — optional day-one, mandatory if Storage tab ships.

## 3. Drag Folder to Tab — Root Cause + Fix Spec (Paste Preview, Conflict, Progress, Cancel)

### 3.1 Code trace (prod2_vgood baseline, identical in eiga/develop)

**Registrations (`chrome.rs`, `content.rs`):**

- `chrome.rs:29-36` — `enum DropTarget { Folder(Location), Place(Location), Tag(String), Trash, Pin(Location) }`
- `chrome.rs:40-48` — thread-local `DROP_TARGETS: Vec<(DropTarget,Rect)>`, `drop_target_at(p) = rev().find(|(_,r)| r.contains(p))`
- `chrome.rs:548,594,633,690` — sidebar Places/Folders/Tags push `Place/Folder/Tag`
- `chrome.rs:579` — Favorites `Pin(src)` zone while dragging
- `content.rs:470,630` — grid/list folder items push `Folder(e.loc)`
- `chrome.rs:1091` (breadcrumb) and **`chrome.rs:1135`** (tabs): `if let Route::Loc(l) = … { DROP_TARGETS.push((Place(l), r)) }` for **every** tab (active uses `self.route`, inactive uses `tabs[i].route`)
- `shell.rs:187,190` — `clear_drop_targets()` at start of `draw_window()` (both native + web)

**Drag start (`content.rs:307,343-350`):**

```rust
let resp = ui.interact(hit, Id::unique(("item",&e.loc)), Sense::click_and_drag());
if resp.drag_started() { self.drag = Some(Drag { items, label }); }
```

**Tab hover-switch (`chrome.rs:1137-1157` prod2_vgood):**

```rust
let dropping = self.drag.is_some() && ui.rect_contains_pointer(r) && !active;
if dropping {
  match self.tab_hover { Some((hi,t)) if hi==i => { frac=(now-t)/0.7; draw progress bar; if el>0.7 { self.tab_hover=None; self.push_act(Act::SwitchTab(i)) } }
  _ => self.tab_hover = Some((i,now)) }
} else if matches!(tab_hover, Some((hi,_)) if hi==i) { self.tab_hover = None; }
```

eiga variant (`eiga_latest/chrome.rs:1179-1196`) uses `ctx.data_mut` temp `("tab-hover-open")` + 0.55 s, no progress bar.

**Resolution (`lib.rs:82-115` prod2_vgood, `lib.rs:155-192` develop):** after `draw_window()` (which just repopulated `DROP_TARGETS`):

```rust
if ctx.input(|i| i.pointer.any_released()) {
  if let Some(drag) = self.drag.take() {
    if let Some(pos) = ctx.pointer_latest_pos() {
      if let Some(target) = chrome::drop_target_at(pos) {
        match target {
          Tag(id) => { toggle tags }
          Folder(dest)|Place(dest) => {
            let srcs = drag.items.filter(|s| s != &dest && !dest.starts_with(s) && s.parent() != Some(&dest));
            if srcs.is_empty() { toast("That is already the destination", false) }
            else { cross = srcs.fs != dest.fs; copy = alt||ctrl||cmd||cross; submit_job(Copy|Move) }
          }
          Trash => submit_job(Trash)
          Pin(l) => push TogglePin
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Actions drain is AFTER drag resolve** (`lib.rs:118-133`): `for _ in 0..4 { acts.extend(ACTS); apply }`. So `SwitchTab` queued in same frame as `draw_tabs` is applied **after** drag resolve that frame.

### 3.2 Root causes — why “it opens but doesn’t paste”

Three independent bugs combine to produce the reported symptom. All must be fixed; fixing only the hover timer still leaves paste broken.

**Cause A — Tab-switch rewrites the drop target mid-gesture (frame-order race).** Hover 0.7 s queues `SwitchTab(i)` → drained *after* drag resolve that frame → next frame `tab_load(i)` calls `go()` which clears `sel/search`, reloads `entries` async, and re-renders tabs with **new `tab_i`/`self.route`**. On the release frame, `draw_tabs` now sees the hovered tab as **active** (`active=true`, `dropping=false`) and `DROP_TARGETS` carries `Place(self.route)` for the new active tab. If the user has *already passed* the 0.7 s dwell, they now drop onto the *active* tab strip — which is visually identical but the drag ghost/`tab_hover` progress is gone, and `content.rs`’s `Folder` targets under the pointer (now shifted by spring `tab_h`) can win due to `rev` order (`content` pushes after `sidebar` but before `tabs`; after switch the strip’s `r` moved). In practice users drop *during* the 0.7 s window: at release the queued `SwitchTab` has not yet been applied, but `drop_target_at(pos)` returns `Place(tabs[i].route)` for the *inactive* tab — correct dest — yet the *same frame* also queues `SwitchTab` (if dwell just crossed), so they see the tab open **and** expect paste into the just-opened view; instead the job was submitted to the *old* dest snapshot, then the view reloads and the pasted files are invisible until manual Refresh. The toast (`“Moving … to X”`) fires but the newly opened folder does not yet contain them (async `list()` in flight). **Fix must freeze dest at drop time, not post-switch route.**

**Cause B — Silent filter empties `srcs` with a misleading toast.** `Folder/Place` branch filters `s != dest && !dest.starts_with(s) && s.parent() != Some(&dest)`. Common case: user drags a subfolder onto the tab that *is its parent* (tabs are usually Home / Downloads / Documents = parents of most items). Then `s.parent()==dest` → `srcs` empty → `toast("That is already the destination", false)` in red. User reads as *failure* (“doesn’t paste”). It is technically a no-op for Move, but for **Copy** (Ctrl/Alt held) it *should* copy into parent under `name (1)`-style (or conflict dialog) — today both Move and Copy are killed identically. Same for cross-tab drag where source and dest fs differ but `dest.starts_with(s)` check on strings mis-fires for `/home/user` vs `/home/user2` without trailing-slash guard (code uses `starts_with` on `Location` which is correct, but `s.parent()` string equality is fragile for `/`).

**Cause C — No paste preview/conflict/progress/cancel wiring for tab drops.** `ops.rs:56-81` `unique_name()` *silently* renames collisions to `name (1).ext` (no Ask). `backend.rs:submit()` → `ops::run()` → `copy_tree()` with progress `Progress::bump` (coalesced 200/job) and `cancel` flag — correct — but the UI for tab drops shows only a toast (`“Moving …”`), no conflict preview (“2 will be renamed”), no byte total (only `measure()` sum, recursive `list()` which is expensive for dirs), no Jobs card cancel for the tab context (Jobs card exists in `overlays::draw_jobs_card` but not linked to drag), no “View in target” action. On cross-fs (`cross=true`) it forces Copy but never explains why. If `rename` fails cross-device, it falls through to `copy_tree` + `remove` — failure there surfaces only as `JobEvent::Failed` toast *after* the view already switched.

**Why “opens now” appeared fixed:** Adding the 0.7 s hover (`tab_hover`) made the target folder visible before drop, but because the drop still resolves to the *stale* `Place` snapshot *and* the subsequent `SwitchTab`+`load()` races the `list()` refresh, files land in the folder but the user is looking at a stale listing. The bug is not *no job* — it is *job submitted to wrong/frozen dest with no arrival guarantee + no conflict honesty*.

### 3.3 Fix spec — paste preview, conflict, progress, cancel (must all ship)

**Freeze & split drop vs navigate (lib.rs + chrome.rs + app.rs):**

1. **Never `SwitchTab` while `drag.is_some()` unless dwell is explicit and cancellable.** Keep 0.55 s dwell (eiga) but require `resp.hovered()` *and* pointer roughly still (±8 px) for the whole dwell. Draw 2.5 px progress bar (`pb`) + label *“Open {title} · keep dragging to drop here”* + `Esc` cancels preview (`tab_hover=None`, drag continues). Add `Act::CancelTabPreview` on Esc. On `SwitchTab` from tab_hover, **record `frozen_dest = tabs[i].route` at queue time** in `Drag { frozen: Option<Location> }` — drop always uses frozen dest, never post-switch `self.route`.
2. **Drop on inactive tab ≠ navigate.** If release happens *before* dwell fires, submit directly to `tabs[i].route` **without** switching. If after dwell (switched), submit to `frozen_dest` (same value) and **do not** submit to new `self.route` if it differs. Split `DropTarget::Place` → `DropTarget::Tab { index, dest }` vs `DropTarget::Place(dest)` (sidebar) vs `DropTarget::Folder(dest)` (content). Resolution order: `Tab` > `Folder` > `Place` > `Pin` > `Trash` (explicit priority, not just `rev`).
3. **Correct the Move-vs-Copy filter.** `s.parent()==dest` is no-op only for `Move`; for `Copy` (Ctrl/Alt/Cmd or cross-fs) it must prompt conflict dialog (see below) and Copy. Change branch to: `if copy { /* never filter on parent; always conflict-check */ } else { /* Move: filter parent+self+descendant */ }`. Cross-fs always Copy (honest toast *“Copying (different disk) …”*).
4. **String `starts_with` guard:** use `Location::starts_with` (already fs-aware) + trailing-slash invariant; add unit test `dest=/home/user2` does **not** match `src=/home/user/file`.

**Paste preview (ghost + tab strip):**

5. `overlays::draw_drag_ghost` (already exists) must show for tab drops: `“Move/Paste 3 items · 412 MB to Downloads”` + conflict chip if `unique_name` would rename ≥1 (`“1 will be renamed”`). Tab `dropping` state draws `accent_tint` fill + 1.5 px stroke + bottom progress bar (existing) **plus** count badge. `DropTarget::Pin` preview already says *“Pin to Favorites”* — keep.
6. Hovering a folder target (`Folder`) shows *“Move into Photos · 3 items”*; hovering Trash shows *“Move to Trash · reversible”* (no destructive surprise).

**Conflict dialog (new `Modal::Conflict`):**

7. Before `submit_job(Copy|Move)` for tab/folder drops, run `backend::check_conflicts(srcs,dest)` (cheap `exists()` per name, plus `measure()` total bytes, no recursive walk). If 0 conflicts → submit immediately + toast with **Undo** (develop pills). If ≥1 conflict → `Modal::Conflict { srcs, dest, conflicts: Vec<(src,dst,reason)> }` with per-file rows: *Keep Both* (default, `unique_name` → `name (1)`), *Replace* (danger, `overwrite=2`), *Skip* (`overwrite=1`). Buttons: *“Apply to all”* + *“Review each”* + *“Cancel”*. `Overwrite` setting (`Ask/Skip/Replace`) seeds default; dialog overrides per-drop. Never silently `name (1)` without showing it.
8. **Reversible everywhere:** `Move` → Undo `Restore` (develop `UndoOp::Restore` → `restore_trashed` + `trash::os_limited`); `Copy` → Undo `Discard` (trash the copies); `Replace` → before overwrite, move victim to Trash (never `remove` directly). All three wired to `toast_action` pills (develop `overlays.rs:557` `pills` Area). No destructive without dialog ([PROMPT1-3]).

**Progress + cancel:**

9. `submit_job` already emits `JobEvent::Started/Progress/Finished/Failed` with `done/total/current`. For tab drops, Jobs card (`overlays::draw_jobs_card`) must auto-open on tab-drop jobs, pill in appbar (`chrome.rs: Jobs pill`) must show `frac` + `Cancel` (calls `be.cancel_job(id)` → `cancel` flag checked in `ops::copy_tree` loop + `Trash/Delete` loop). Cancel is **atomic**: partial copies removed (`dv.remove(dst)` on cancel in `copy_tree:129-132`), no half-folder left. `Failed` shows inline error + *Retry* (no silent swallow).
10. After `Finished`, **navigate honestly**: if drop was to inactive tab, toast has *“View {dest}”* action (`Act::Nav(Route::Loc(dest))`) — never auto-switch tabs after paste (user already has focus elsewhere). `select_after_list = created` + `list()` ensures files visible where they landed.

**External drag (unknown-unknown gap):** Today only *internal* drags (content → chrome) work. `egui` has no OS file drop. Spec: use `eframe` `viewport` drag-drop (`ctx.raw.dropped_files`) on native to accept Nautilus/Finder drops on windows/tabs with same preview/conflict path. If not implemented at launch, show *“Drag between windows only — external drops not supported yet”* ghost (honest, not silent). Track as P1.

**Tests (gate $299):** (a) drag `/A` onto Tab(B) before dwell → copies to B, view stays on A, toast Undo. (b) hover 0.7 s → preview switches, still drop to B, files appear after refresh. (c) drag child onto parent tab with Ctrl → Conflict dialog (Keep Both). (d) drag onto same folder → helpful *“Already here”* + *“Copy here anyway?”*. (e) Cancel mid-copy → partial removed, no `name (1)` litter.

## 7. Phone / USB Discovery UX — Why Phone Never Appeared

### 7.1 What user sees today

- Sidebar `Locations` (`chrome.rs:587-610`): iterates `self.devices: Vec<Device>` from `Backend::new_native()` → `providers.iter().flat_map(|p| p.list())`. Providers: `SystemDevices` (sysinfo + `lsblk`) + `AdbDevices` **only if** `adb::adb_available()` (`backend.rs:107-109`).
- Each row (`sb_row_device`): icon `d.kind.icon()` (`ssd-square`/`sd-card`/`global`/`smartphone`/`cloud`), name, `Mount` text if unmounted, `Mount` click → `Act::Mount(id)` → `p.mount(id)` (`udisksctl mount`/`gio mount`), battery `%` for Phone. Unmounted rows are **dimmed** (`dim=0.55`) but still clickable.
- `Modal::Devices` (680×580 or 700×620 grid in prod2_huge): 2-col cards with `Mount/Open/Unmount/Eject/Continuity` buttons (`modals.rs:776-880`), capacity bar (`used_fraction()`), `detail` line (`d.detail · capacity_text()`).
- `Modal::Phone` (560×560/470): Continuity card (see `chrome:600` → `Act::Modal(Modal::Phone)`). No diagnostics beyond battery.
- `Storage card` (sidebar footer, `chrome.rs:800-824`): `current_device()` (longest-prefix `loc.fs` match) + `% used` + bar + gear → Settings. If no device matches, shows *“Computer”* 0% (not an error).

### 7.2 Root cause — phone invisible by design

```rust
// backend.rs:102-122
let mut providers = vec![Arc::new(SystemDevices)];
if adb::adb_available() { providers.push(Arc::new(AdbDevices)); }
// then auto-mount adb:
for d in b.devices.lock().unwrap().iter() { if d.id.starts_with("adb:") { p.mount(&d.id) … } }
```

- `SystemDevices::list()` only enumerates **block devices** (`sysinfo::Disks` + `lsblk -J -b -o NAME,PATH,LABEL,SIZE,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINT,RM,TRAN,TYPE,HOTPLUG,MODEL`). A phone in **MTP/PTP mode** is **not** a block device, not in `REAL_FS` list, not `/media|/run/media`. It is invisible here.
- `AdbDevices::list()` parses `adb devices -l` (lines with `" device "`), extracts `model:` → `Device { id:"adb:<serial>", kind:Phone, mounted:true, loc:"adb:<serial>:/sdcard", total:0, free:0, battery: dumpsys }`. Mount is `AdbVfs` (`adb shell ls/cat/mv/rm`). **If user plugged phone without `USB debugging` + authorized + `adb` on PATH, or in *Charge only* / *MTP* mode, `adb devices` returns `unauthorized/offline` or `(no devices)`.** `query()` filters `contains(" device ")` — so `unauthorized`, `offline`, `recovery` are silently dropped. `adb_available()` checks `adb version` — if `adb` missing, provider never registered.
- **No MTP/GVfs provider at all.** There is no `gio list`, `gphoto2 --auto-detect`, `gvfs-mtp`, or `udisks` MTP handling. `Connect a server` (`connect_server("mtp://…")` → `gio mount`) is hidden behind Settings → Storage → *Connect a server* (`Modal::Connect`), not in Devices modal, with only generic toast on failure.
- **No UDEV/hotplug rescan.** `devices()` refreshes only on `Event::Devices` after `mount/unmount` or `refresh_devices()` (manual). `watch()` (`notify`) watches only the *current* folder; USB plug does not trigger `refresh_devices()` automatically (no `udisk` watcher thread). User must restart app or open Devices modal (`Modal::Devices` path calls `refresh_devices` in `Act::Modal` — `app.rs:1171-1173` — which helps only if they discover the modal).
- **No error surfacing.** `SystemDevices::lsblk()` failure returns `vec![]` silently. `AdbDevices::query()` failure `vec![]`. `device_op` `Err("Unknown device")` toasts, but *absence* is silent. Sidebar shows nothing + no *“No USB devices — check cable”* empty state.

**Net:** Phone in MTP mode → provider absent → list empty → user sees no phone, no mount indicator, no error, no hint to enable USB debugging or install `adb`/`gvfs-backends`.

### 7.3 Fix spec — mount indicator, fallback, error surfacing

**Providers to add (in order):**

| Provider | When | `Device` fields | `Vfs` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SystemDevices` (keep) | `lsblk`+sysinfo | `Internal/Removable/Optical/Network` as today | `file` (real path) |
| `AdbDevices` (keep, fix) | `adb devices -l` | Phone, `battery`, `loc:/sdcard` | `AdbVfs` (shell `ls/cat`) — fix parser for `unauthorized/offline` to surface *“authorize on phone”* |
| **`MtpDevices` (new)** | `gio list` / `gphoto2 --auto-detect` / `gvfs` MTP (`/run/user/1000/gvfs/…`) | Phone, `total:0` (or `gphoto` capacity), `detail:"MTP · <model>"`, `mounted:true`, `loc: Location::new("mtp:<id>","/")` | `MtpVfs` via `gio`/`gphoto2` or via mount point under `gvfs` (read/write through `LocalVfs` on gvfs path, read-only for some devices honestly) |
| **`UdevMonitor` (new watcher)** | `udev` `add/remove` for `usb`/`block` | Triggers `refresh_devices()` debounced 500 ms | — |

**UI spec:**

- **Sidebar `Locations`:** mounted = solid icon + name + capacity; unmounted = dim + *“Mount”* right-aligned (today exists — keep). Phone MTP/ADB rows use `smartphone` icon + battery `%` or *“MTP”* chip. Add **empty state**: if `devices.is_empty()` show *“No USB devices — plug in a drive or phone, then Rescan”* + *Rescan* button (`refresh_devices`).
- **Mount indicator:** `sb_row_device` already shows `Mount`/`Eject` on hover + capacity. Add persistent dot: green = mounted, grey = unmounted, amber = *“needs unlock/authorize”* (`unauthorized`). Device card in `Modal::Devices` shows same + *Details* (bus, serial, `lsblk` line).
- **Fallbacks:** `Mount` failure → inline error in card (*“udisksctl: not authorized — click to try `gio mount`”*) + *Copy diagnostics* (runs `lsblk`, `adb devices`, `lsusb`, `gio info <id>` into clipboard). Never just toast.
- **Error surfacing:** `DeviceOp Err` toasts today (`app.rs:885`). Upgrade to `Modal::Info` with reason + *“Open Terminal: lsusb”* action. If `adb` missing, Devices modal header shows *“ADB not found — install `adb` (`sudo apt install adb`) for Android browsing; MTP works without it”* (probe `adb_available()` once, cache).
- **Auto-rescan:** `UdevMonitor` thread (`udev` crate or `notify` on `/dev/bus/usb`) → `refresh_devices()`; sidebar count badge pulses; toast *“USB drive mounted: <name>”* (only on transition unmounted→mounted, not every refresh). Manual *Rescan* in Devices modal.

**Acceptance:** Plug MTP phone (no debugging) → appears in <3 s as *Phone · MTP · model*, click opens `/`, thumb/grid work, drag USB→phone copies via `ops` (cross-fs `Copy`), safe-remove ejects. Plug Android with debugging → `adb:` row + battery, *“authorize”* banner if `unauthorized`. Unplug → row disappears + toast *“Phone disconnected”* (no stale `Mounted`).

## 8. Performance + Unknown Unknowns

### 8.1 Current perf shape (honest)

- **Listing:** `backend::list()` spawns thread per `list()` (`spawn`), `listed` event async; `set_entries` builds `entries` + `rebuild_view` (filter hidden, `sort_entries` — `O(n log n)` with `natural_cmp` unless `natural_sort` off), `sections` grouping, `summaries` for up to 80 subfolders (`be.summarize()` each → `list()` again). For 10k files, `entries Vec<Entry>` (~10k × ~200 B = 2 MB) + textures dominate. No virtualized row reuse beyond viewport `ITEM_RECTS` intersect check (`content.rs:132`). Scroll is `egui ScrollArea` immediate-mode — per-frame re-layout of all visible rows.
- **Search:** `search.rs` cached index (`IndexData` per `fs+root`, 600 s TTL, `JUNK` skip). First search walks tree + streams hits (capped 400, `hits.truncate(400)`), then caches; later searches rank via `nucleo-matcher` + `rayon` parallel. `run_search` debounce 100 ms (`lib.rs:46`). Content search reads 2 MB/file. Indexed path is ms; cold path is seconds for large home.
- **Thumbs:** 2 threads + LIFO + `seen` dedupe. Video adds `ffmpeg` fork + `image` decode + `TextureHandle`. `thumbs` HashMap unbounded (leak, see P8).
- **Summaries/tree:** `summarize()` per subfolder (each `list()`), `tree_flat` depth-first to 300 nodes, 3 s `tree_cache` TTL (`chrome.rs:462`). Every `load()` re-summarizes places (`app.rs:538`).
- **Jobs:** `ops::measure()` recurses `list()` per file to total bytes (`ops.rs:83-90`) — for 100 GB copy, full tree walk *before* first byte. `copy_tree` buffers 256 KiB, `Progress::bump` coalesces ~200/job. `Trash/Delete` per-file `Progress` events.
- **Watchers:** `notify::RecommendedWatcher` non-recursive, coalesced in develop (150 ms `pending`) vs raw in prod2 (spin risk: listing triggers atime → Changed → listing loop). Develop’s coalesce is the fix to keep.
- **Memory:** `thumbs`, `big_thumbs`, `summaries`, `place_counts`, `tree_cache`, `app_icons` (decoded 96 px), `icons.cache` (per-name/code/px textures, unbounded), `jobs` HashMap, `search.indexes` Arc<Vec<Entry>> per root, `storage Scan` nodes (if shipped). No LRU — **600 MB growth** with large folders/photos is expected (P8).

### 8.3 Unknown unknowns — deliberately beyond prompt1 (each ships or explicitly wont-fixes)

1. **Broken symlinks / symlink loops:** `local.rs:8` `follow symlinks for metadata; broken links fall back to link itself` — listed but `stat()` for broken link fails → entry shows `size 0`, `kind Other`, no *“Broken link”* badge, open toasts *“no longer available”*. Fix: `Entry.symlink + is_broken` flag, badge, *Remove link* action (not target).
2. **Permission denied (chmod 000, read-only mounts):** `list()` returns `Err(PermissionDenied)` → `Event::Listed Err` → `error` banner *“Can’t open this folder”* + *Go Home* (current). Missing: *“Open as root (pkexec)”* hint, `Unlock` button, `ls -l` diagnostic. Read-only device Delete must explain.
3. **Case-sensitive collisions:** Linux `Readme` vs `readme`, Unicode NFC/NFD (`café`): `unique_name` `exists()` check is case-sensitive (correct on Linux) but `Location` equality is byte-equal — drag `A` onto `a` folder parent may silently rename to `a (1)` without dialog. Need Conflict dialog (§3) with case + Unicode normalization note.
4. **Long / invalid filenames:** 255-byte limit, NUL, newline, emoji, RTL names: `fit()` truncates by char count, `p.text` may overflow; rename validation only checks `/` (`backend.rs:268`). Fix: validate 255 + NUL + `.`/`..`, show inline error, no truncation of extension (show `name… .ext`).
5. **UTF-8 / grapheme:** `fit()` slices `chars` then `trim_end` — breaks ZWJ emoji + combining marks. Use grapheme width (`unicode_width`).
6. **Offline / network mounts (NFS/CIFS/SSHFS):** `SystemDevices` lists them as `Network`, `list()` blocks on thread (OK) but no timeout — hung NFS freezes `summarize(80×)`. Fix: 3 s timeout per `list`, stale-while-revalidate, *“Network location unavailable — Retry”*.
7. **File watcher limits (inotify 128k):** `watch()` treats `watch Err` as silent (`is_ok()` check). With recursive tools, files change without refresh. Fix: toast *“Live updates paused (watch limit) — Refresh needed”* + manual Refresh prominence.
8. **Disk full / quota:** `copy_tree` `create_write` fails mid-job → `Failed` toast only. Missing: pre-flight `capacity()` check (total vs `measure`) + *“Not enough space (need X, have Y)”* before job, partial cleanup.
9. **Archive bombs / ZipCrypto:** `archive.rs` handles `deflate+ZipCrypto` but no bomb guard (zip size vs uncompressed ratio). Add limit (e.g., 50 k files / 20 GB) + *“Archive too large”* error before extract.
10. **Thumbnail cache exhaustion:** `~/.cache/smart-files/thumbs` unbounded (prod2). Fix LRU 500 MB + *Reset thumbnails* in Settings (§4).
11. **Icon cache leak:** `icons.cache` HashMap `(name,code,px) → TextureHandle` unbounded (every px size from DPI change adds entry). Cap + `LRU` or `px` quantize to 4 sizes.
12. **Search index staleness:** 600 s TTL + `invalidate(loc)` only on mutate paths that call it; external edits via watcher rely on `Changed` → `invalidate` (backend does). If watcher missed, index wrong. Fix: `SearchDone.cached` badge + *Rebuild* button always.
13. **Clipboard cross-app:** `copy_text` (`pending_copy`) only handles text/path, not `x-special/gnome-copied-files` file list. Dragging from Files to Nautilus / vice versa fails silently. Fix: set `x-special` + `text/uri-list` on Copy, accept `dropped_files` on drop (see §3 External drag).
14. **Multi-window session:** `WinOpen/WinClose/WinMin/WinZoom` + `OpenNewWindow` spawns new exe without session restore (`tabs`, `route`, `sidebar`). Fix: persist `library` JSON includes `tabs/routes` (P1) or document single-window.
15. **High DPI / fractional scaling:** `icons.paint` `px = rect.width()*ppp` clamped 8–256; `resize_handles` zones `ei=3, eo=7` px are device-independent — on 200% they shrink relative. Fix: scale hitzones by `ppp`, quantize icon px.
16. **Keyboard focus trap:** `handle_keys` returns early when `egui_wants_keyboard_input()`; TextEdit (search/rename/AI) steals arrows. Today arrow nav checks `!typing` partially; search sheet `Esc` handling inconsistent. Fix: explicit focus model (Search vs Files vs Modal) + `Ctrl+F` focus, `Esc` hierarchy already in develop — keep.
17. **Screen reader / a11y:** No `accesskit` roles, no focus visible ring, `reduce_motion` respected for `anim()` but not for `spring_to`/drag ghost. Add `egui::accesskit` labels for tabs/sidebar/content, visible focus, `Ctrl+?` shortcuts sheet already exists — ensure TalkBack/NVDA order.
18. **Empty folder / Recents cross-device:** Recents stores `Location` (fs+path); after unmount, `filter_map(stat.ok())` silently drops (app.rs:635). Show *“Moved/deleted”* tombstone with *Remove* instead of vanishing.
19. **Sort stability:** `sort_entries` + `group_idx` stable? `rebuild_view` re-sorts; equal keys may flicker. Use `sort_by` (unstable) → change to stable `sort_by`.
20. **Time zone / date:** `format_date` uses Local; imported files with UTC timestamps off-by-hours. Show *“Modified <full date> (local)”* in Info (today does `format_full_date` — keep).
21. **Hidden files + `.trashinfo` leak:** `show_hidden=false` hides dotfiles but Trash `info/*.trashinfo` still under `~/.local/share/Trash/info` — user sees `Trash/info` if they browse Home hidden. Hide Trash `info` explicitly.
22. **Firmware / VFS perms:** `Vfs::is_writable()` defaults true; `LocalVfs` always true even on read-only mount. `Mount` succeeds but writes fail. Fix: `is_writable` checks mount flags/`capacity`.
23. **Cancel race:** `cancel_job` sets flag; `ops` checks per file/256 KiB; `PacedJob` ignores cancel (wall-clock). Delete paced path removes race.
24. **Future:** `smart.toml` contract drift — Settings persists `Library` JSON; version bump breaks load. Add `version` field + migration.

## 9. Memory + Rescan + Threading Fix Spec [PROMPT1-8]

**Leak (600 MB):** `thumbs: HashMap<Location,Tex>` + `big_thumbs` (unbounded, each keeps `TextureHandle` = GPU+CPU copy). `summaries: HashMap<Location,(usize,u64)>` per subfolder visited. `tree_cache` per `Location` 3 s. `app_icons` per `path`. `icons.cache` per `(name,code,px)`. `search.indexes: Vec<Arc<IndexData>>` (each holds `entries: Vec<Entry>` full tree). `storage Scan nodes` (if shipped, incremental but retains whole tree until done). `jobs` HashMap retains `cancel` until `Finished/Failed` removed (OK). `walls: Vec<(sharp,blur)>` 4× `image::load` (~15 MB each, textures stay).

**Fix:**

- **Cap every cache (LRU, explicit):** `thumbs` 400 (grid) + `big_thumbs` 8, `summaries` 500, `tree_cache` 200, `app_icons` 100, `icons.cache` 300, `search.indexes` 4 (one per root, 600 s TTL already), `jobs` 20. Evict oldest `TextureHandle` via `free()` (`tex.free()`), `summaries` oldest, `tree_cache` oldest. Implement `LruMap` helper (std only, no crate).
- **Texture lifetime:** `thumbs` entries for off-screen rows freed after 10 s idle (check `ITEM_RECTS` intersect). `icons.cache` quantize `px` to {16,20,24,32,48,96} to stop DPI explosion.
- **Delete `walls`** (see §4) frees ~60 MB at startup.
- **Rescan dumbness:** Today prod2 storage `scan(home)` sync walks `target/node_modules/.cache/__pycache__/.next/.venv/vendor` via `walk_names(depth 3)` + `walk_logs` + `walk_empty` + `walk_big` + `dir_size(depth 4-6, files>20k early-exit)` — called on UI thread inside `draw_clean` button handler (`storage.rs:223`). Traversing trees is expensive and blocking. **Replace with eiga `analyze::Scan::step(vfs, max_dirs)` incremental**: desktop thread (`std::thread "storage-scan"` 6 dirs/step, 1 ms sleep) vs web slice (45/step), `progress()`, `snapshot()` every 250 ms, `rescan_at` 2 s after clean. Adopt eiga `storage.rs` + `analyze.rs` wholesale for Storage tab; delete prod2 `storage.rs: scan/dir_size/walk_*` sync version.
- **Threading & crates:** Keep `exec::spawn` (std threads) for list/search/thumb/jobs. Search already uses `rayon` for ranking (keep `nucleo-matcher + rayon`); thumbs uses 2 std threads (keep, no `tokio`). `walkdir`/`ignore` for search walk (respects `.gitignore`, skips `JUNK` already), `rayon` for `measure` per top-level child. No new runtime crates beyond `walkdir`, `notify` (already), `trash` (already, via `trash::os_limited`), `dirs`, `chrono`. `ffmpeg/ffprobe` via `Command` (no `ffmpeg-next` link), `gphoto2`/`gio` via `Command` for MTP.
- **Invalidate smartly:** Replace `watch()` raw `Changed` per event (prod2) with develop coalesce (150 ms, `EventKind` filter: ignore `Access/Others/Metadata`, only Create/Remove/Modify-content). `search::invalidate(loc)` only for covering indexes (`starts_with` both ways already). `summaries` invalidated only for `touched` parent dirs after job (`ops` already returns `touched`).

**Acceptance:** Browse 5k photos + 10k files, RSS stays <200 MB (checked via `top`/`heaptrack` or `ps` after 2 min scroll). Click Storage *Scan* → progress bar moves, UI never hangs >16 ms/frame; *Clean* → rescan 2 s later shows reduced reclaimable, no full re-walk if idle.

Today `Cargo.toml` workspace: `smart-core`, `smart-ui-egui`, `xtask`. `smart-ui-egui` is a binary+lib (`cdylib+rlib`) but **app-coupled**: `lib.rs` drives `SmartApp` (Files state) inside `eframe::App::ui`, `shell.rs` hardcodes `AppId::Files|Photos|Terminal`, `chrome.rs` draws Files window inside shell. crates/

### P1-10 · Search 1-char / last-letter bug on small windows [P0]

- **Root cause:** Two input paths for the same `search.query` string:
  1. **Appbar field** (`chrome.rs:1218 draw_search`): `TextEdit::singleline` with `Id::unique("search-input")` + `focus_next` logic. When `space < 560` (`compact`), field collapses to 34 px **icon button** (`chrome.rs:945-955`) that opens `SearchSheet` (`overlays.rs:993`) instead. The sheet has its own `TextEdit` + `q = take(&mut search.query)` swap.
  2. **Type-ahead** (`lib.rs:374-388`): `egui::Event::Text(t)` → if `typeahead` true, **accumulates while `time-type_at<0.9s`** (prod2) else `query = t.clone()` (develop/prod1). Also sets `focus_next=true` + `run_search()` + `return`.
  
  On a **small window** (`compact`), typing goes to type-ahead (no TextEdit focused, header is icon). First letter `.` → `query="."` (1 char) → `run_search()` → `search_active()` true → appbar draws icon with badge, **content switches to `draw_search_results`** (`content.rs:742`) whose empty-state/help focuses `SearchSheet`? `focus_next=true` steals focus back to the *icon* button (not sheet) → next keystroke `a` overwrites `query="a"` (type-ahead resets because `type_at` tracking + `focus_next` churn) → *“always selects last letter, only 1-char search”*. On a **large window**, the real `TextEdit` has focus, each keystroke appends normally, `dirty_at` debounce 100 ms batches → *“highlights all words”* (correct incremental `highlight_name` over whole query). Additional coupling: `chrome::draw_search` does `q=take(&mut query); …; query=q; if before!=query { dirty_at=time; push RunSearch }` — with `Id::unique` id, egui remounts TextEdit on every `take` swap, resetting selection/cursor when window resizes (compact↔full flip mid-type). `type_buf/type_at` in prod2 (`app.rs:397-398`) intended to fix accumulate but `develop` still uses `query=t.clone()` without accumulate — so develop also flickers.
- **Fix:** **One search field, one owner.** (a) Never use `Text` events for search when appbar `TextEdit` is mounted. Type-ahead applies only when **no** TextEdit focused (`!egui_wants_keyboard_input()`) and `!compact` *or* `typing==false`. In `compact`, `FocusSearch` opens `SearchSheet` modal and *moves keyboard focus* (`focus_next` → `TextEdit.request_focus()`) — type-ahead disabled while sheet open. (b) Fix accumulate: prod2’s 0.9 s accumulate is correct; unify — `if time-type_at<0.9 && query not empty { query.push_str(t) } else { query=t }` in all builds (develop currently overwrites). (c) `Id::unique("search-input")` → stable `Id::new("search-input")` (not unique) so resize across 560 px threshold keeps cursor/selection. (d) `dirty_at` debounce stays 100 ms; `last_sent` guard prevents duplicate `RunSearch`. (e) Standalone sheet and appbar share **same `search.query`** but different `Id` (`sheet-input` vs `search-input`) — never both mounted (`compact ? sheet : field` exclusive). (f) After `run_search()`, focus stays in field (do not `focus_next` on every key — only on `FocusSearch` action).
- **Acceptance:** At 500 px width, type `.appimage` → query becomes `.appimage` (8 chars), results filter `ext:appimage` + name contains, no single-char flicker, `highlight_name` highlights full `.appimage`. At 900 px, same string accumulates identically. Esc clears search, focus returns to content (not icon). Resize 500→900 mid-type preserves cursor. Add regression test: simulate `Text(".")`, `Text("a")`… sequence at compact width → `search.query==".appimage"`.

### P1-11 · Real mimetypes, Solar-style, not hardcoded extensions [P0]

- **Root cause:** `model.rs:Kind::from_ext` (`model.rs:89-100`) is a **hardcoded extension list** (`jpg→Image`, `mp4→Video`, etc.) — ~70 extensions guessed. `kind_label()` branches on `ext` string (`TOML/JSON/…`). `icons` map `Kind→Solar glyph` (`folder/gallery/music-note/clapperboard/document-text/text/terminal/archive/widget/…`). `apps.rs:mime_of` *does* use `mime_guess::from_path` — but only for `Open With` filtering (`apps_for`). Kind/icon for files *ignores* MIME, reads extension. Humans recognize by *visual* (icon+thumb) not by `.ext` — wrong Kind = wrong icon+color+thumb+previewability.
  Failures today: `.AppImage` (uppercase) → `from_ext` lowercases → `App` OK, but `.extension` upper-case preserved for label (`APPIMAGE→Linux app`) — fragile. New types (`.webp` OK, `.heic` OK) but `.heic` on Linux `image` crate may fail to decode → thumb blank. `.heic` vs `image/heic`, `.mkv` vs `video/x-matroska`, `.log` → `Text` but should be `Code`/`Log`? `.md` → `Text` but preview as rendered? `.dmg/.exe` → `App` but no exec bit distinction. Extension-rename attack: rename `evil.jpg` → `evil.mp4` → thumb decode fails → blank, no error.
- **Fix (Solar implicit-correct):** Keep `Kind` for coarse UX groups (Folder/Image/Audio/Video/…) but derive from **real MIME** via `mime_guess::from_path` + `shared-mime-info` where available (`mime` string → `Kind` map), with extension as *fallback* only when MIME is `octet-stream`. `Entry.mime: String` + `Entry.kind` derived via `mime_to_kind(mime, name)` (pure, unit-tested). Icon selection: `Kind` → Solar glyph (keep `kind.icon()`), but **also** resolve raster icon for Open With (`app_icon_tex`) and document icon for unknown (`file`). Expose real MIME in Get Info (`Kind` + `MIME: image/jpeg` + `Kind: Image`, `file --mime-type` equivalent for native). Cache `mime` per `Entry` at `stat` (no I/O per draw). `Kind::from_ext` becomes deprecated fallback, not primary. Unit tests: `mime_to_kind("image/heic", "HEIC")→Image`, `video/x-matroska→Video`, `application/octet-stream + .mp4→Video` (via ext fallback with *“guessed from extension”* tooltip).
- **Acceptance:** Same MIME different ext (`photo.jpg` vs `photo.JPG` vs `photo.jpeg`) → same icon/color/thumb. `movie.mkv` (`video/x-matroska`) → Video glyph + thumb attempt (ffmpeg), not `Other/Document`. Get Info shows real MIME; no hardcoded extension list drives icons (grep `Kind::from_ext` only in `mime_to_kind` fallback).

### Drag-Folder-to-Tab Bug

**Trace:** `chrome.rs:1135` pushes `Place` per tab, `chrome.rs:1137` dwell 0.7s `tab_hover`→`SwitchTab`, `lib.rs:82` resolves on `any_released()` via `drop_target_at()` (`rev` order), `ops.rs:56 unique_name` silently renames, `ops.rs:83 measure` walks tree pre-job.

**Root causes (3): A)** `SwitchTab` drained *after* drag resolve rewrites `self.route`/listing mid-gesture → drop goes to stale `Place` then view reloads, files land but invisible until Refresh. **B)** Filter `s.parent()==dest` kills Copy too (parent tab) with `“already destination”` toast. **C)** No preview/conflict/progress/cancel for tab drops (only toast).

**Fix spec (§3.3):** Freeze `dest` at drag-start (`Drag.frozen`), split `Tab{index,dest}` priority `Tab>Folder>Place`, require 0.55s still-over-tab + progress + Esc cancel, Move-vs-Copy filter split, green *“Move N·size to X·conflict”* ghost, new `Modal::Conflict` (Keep Both/Replace/Skip/All/Cancel, seeded by `overwrite`), Jobs card auto-open + Cancel atomic, toast Undo pills (`restore/discard/rename`), View-in-target action, external drag via `dropped_files/arboard` or honest unsupported.
